fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: If you travel without a visa, your passport should be valid for the proposed duration of your stay, with no additional validity required.
entry.es: Si viajas sin visa, tu pasaporte debe ser válido durante la estancia prevista, sin exigirse validez adicional.
entry.quote: If you’re travelling without a visa, your passport should be valid for the proposed duration of your stay. No additional period of validity beyond this is required.

entry.en: Completing an immigration card is listed among the requirements at the border.
entry.es: Rellenar una tarjeta de inmigración figura entre los requisitos en la frontera.

entry.en: At the border you need to have evidence of sufficient funds.
entry.es: En la frontera debes tener pruebas de fondos suficientes.
entry.quote: have evidence of sufficient funds. You can show:

entry.en: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.
entry.es: Debes declarar todo lo que pueda estar prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles.
entry.quote: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

entry.en: Cash up to a maximum of $10,000 or €10,000 and equivalents must be declared on entering or leaving Ukraine.
entry.es: El efectivo de hasta 10.000 dólares o 10.000 euros y equivalentes debe declararse al entrar o salir de Ucrania.
entry.quote: Cash up to a maximum of $10,000, €10,000 and its equivalents must be declared upon entry or leaving Ukraine.

entry.en: It is illegal to enter Ukrainian territory through a border point not currently controlled by the Ukrainian authorities.
entry.es: Es ilegal entrar al territorio ucraniano por un paso fronterizo que las autoridades ucranianas no controlan actualmente.
entry.quote: It is illegal to enter internationally recognised Ukrainian territory through a border point that is not currently controlled by the Ukrainian authorities.

safety.en: Russia continues to invade Ukraine, and missile and drone attacks take place frequently across the country.
safety.es: Rusia sigue invadiendo Ucrania y los ataques con misiles y drones ocurren con frecuencia en todo el país.
safety.quote: Russia continues to invade Ukraine. Russian missile and drone attacks take place frequently across the country.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel to all regions in eastern Ukraine, including territories temporarily under Russian control.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a todas las regiones del este de Ucrania, incluidos los territorios temporalmente bajo control ruso.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to all regions in eastern Ukraine, including any Ukrainian territories which are temporarily under Russian control.

safety.en: Follow the advice of local authorities, including responding to air raid alerts and train evacuation instructions.
safety.es: Sigue las indicaciones de las autoridades locales, incluidas las alertas antiaéreas y las instrucciones de evacuación en trenes.
safety.quote: Follow the advice of local authorities, including responding to air raid alerts and train evacuation instructions.

safety.en: If you come across an unexploded weapon such as a landmine, do not approach or touch it.
safety.es: Si encuentras un arma sin explotar, como una mina, no te acerques ni la toques.
safety.quote: If you come across an unexploded weapon, such as a landmine, do not approach it or touch it.

safety.en: In Kyiv, pickpocketing is described as very common, especially in crowded metro stations.
safety.es: En Kiev se describe el carterismo como muy común, sobre todo en estaciones de metro abarrotadas.
safety.quote: In Kyiv, make sure to guard your bags and person because pickpocketing is very common, especially in crowded metro stations.

safety.en: Ukraine is described as having some of the worst statistics for road-related deaths and injuries in the world.
safety.es: Se describe a Ucrania como uno de los países con peores cifras mundiales de muertes y heridos en carretera.
safety.quote: Ukraine has some of the worst statistics for road-related deaths and injuries in the world so act accordingly.

health.es: Para llamar a una ambulancia, marca el 103.
health.quote: Call 103 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: State medical facilities are generally poor, while private clinics and hospitals offer better care but do not always meet western standards.
health.es: Los centros médicos estatales suelen ser deficientes; las clínicas privadas ofrecen mejor atención, aunque no siempre cumplen los estándares occidentales.
health.quote: State medical facilities in Ukraine are generally poor. Private clinics and hospitals offer a better standard of care, though these do not always meet western standards and practices.

health.en: Because of the invasion, some supply chains are interrupted and some medical products are hard to come by.
health.es: Por la invasión, algunas cadenas de suministro están interrumpidas y algunos productos médicos son difíciles de conseguir.
health.quote: Due to the ongoing invasion, some supply chains are interrupted, and some medical products are hard to come by.

health.es: Las farmacias pueden cerrar sin previo aviso.
health.quote: Pharmacies may close without notice. Maintain a stock of essential medication.

health.en: Wikivoyage advises avoiding tap water as a rule.
health.es: Wikivoyage aconseja evitar el agua del grifo como norma general.
health.quote: As a rule, avoid drinking tap water.

health.en: Wikivoyage says regular travel insurance does not cover injuries caused by drones or shelling.
health.es: Wikivoyage indica que el seguro de viaje normal no cubre lesiones causadas por drones o bombardeos.
health.quote: Regular travel insurance do not cover injuries caused by drones or shelling.

help.en: Emergency numbers are 103 for ambulance, 101 for fire and 102 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son 103 (ambulancia), 101 (bomberos) y 102 (policía).

help.en: Victims of crime should report it to the police by calling 102.
help.es: Las víctimas de un delito deben denunciarlo a la policía llamando al 102.
help.quote: If you are a victim of crime, report it to the police by calling 102.

help.en: After a road accident you must wait for the police and call them on 102.
help.es: Tras un accidente de tráfico debes esperar a la policía y llamarla al 102.
help.quote: If you have a road accident, you must wait for the police to assess the accident. Call the police on 102.

help.en: The Ministry of Health runs a hotline at +380 (0)800 60 20 19 to coordinate access to insulin and other critical medicines.
help.es: El Ministerio de Salud tiene una línea en el +380 (0)800 60 20 19 para coordinar el acceso a insulina y otros medicamentos críticos.
help.quote: The Ukrainian Ministry of Health operates a hotline at +380 (0)800 60 20 19 to coordinate access to insulin and other critical medicines for those who need it.

getting_in.en: Ukraine's airspace has been closed to civil aviation due to the war.
getting_in.es: El espacio aéreo de Ucrania está cerrado a la aviación civil por la guerra.
getting_in.quote: Due to the state of war, Ukraine's airspace has been closed to civil aviation.

getting_in.en: Trains are still running, with direct services from Poland, Hungary, Austria, Slovakia and Moldova.
getting_in.es: Los trenes siguen funcionando, con servicios directos desde Polonia, Hungría, Austria, Eslovaquia y Moldavia.
getting_in.quote: Despite the war, trains are still running. Direct trains run from Poland (Warsaw, Chełm, Przemyśl), Hungary (Budapest, Debrecen), Austria (Vienna), Slovakia (Košice), Moldova (Chișinău).

getting_in.en: Direct buses run from Poland, Hungary, Slovakia, Romania, Moldova, Austria and other countries.
getting_in.es: Hay autobuses directos desde Polonia, Hungría, Eslovaquia, Rumanía, Moldavia, Austria y otros países.
getting_in.quote: Direct buses run from Poland (Warsaw, Kraków, Łódź, Wrocław, Poznań), Hungary (Budapest), Slovakia (Bratislava, Košice), Romania (Bucharest), Moldova (Chișinău, Bălţi), Austria (Vienna)

getting_in.en: Passenger ferry traffic is suspended because of the war.
getting_in.es: El tráfico de pasajeros por mar está suspendido por la guerra.
getting_in.quote: Passenger traffic is suspended because of the war.

getting_in.en: The land borders with Belarus, Russia and Transnistria are closed and will stay closed for the foreseeable future.
getting_in.es: Las fronteras terrestres con Bielorrusia, Rusia y Transnistria están cerradas y seguirán así en el futuro previsible.
getting_in.quote: Due to the Russian invasion of Ukraine, the land borders with Belarus, Russia, and Transnistria are closed and will remain closed for the foreseeable future.

getting_in.en: The Polish-Ukrainian border is about 529km long, and the closest major city near it is Lviv.
getting_in.es: La frontera polaco-ucraniana mide unos 529 km y la gran ciudad más cercana es Leópolis.
getting_in.quote: The Polish-Ukrainian border is about 529km long, and the closest major city near the border is Lviv.

getting_around.en: The marshrutka, a minibus that follows routes like regular buses, is described as the quickest way around big cities.
getting_around.es: La marshrutka, un minibús que sigue rutas como los autobuses, se describe como la forma más rápida de moverse en las grandes ciudades.
getting_around.quote: The quickest way to get around big cities is the so-called marshrutka: the minibuses which follow routes much like the regular buses do.

getting_around.en: The fare is paid on boarding (except in Odesa, where you pay on exiting) and is fixed regardless of distance.
getting_around.es: La tarifa se paga al subir (salvo en Odesa, donde se paga al bajar) y es fija sin importar la distancia.
getting_around.quote: The fare is paid as soon as you get in (except in Odesa, where you pay upon exiting), and is fixed no matter how far you want to go.

getting_around.en: Ukrainian trains are described as old, slow and infrequent by West European standards, but punctual, reliable and very cheap.
getting_around.es: Se describe a los trenes ucranianos como viejos, lentos y poco frecuentes para el estándar europeo, pero puntuales, fiables y muy baratos.
getting_around.quote: Ukrainian trains are quite old and slow by West European standards, and not very frequent, but they are punctual, reliable and very cheap

getting_around.en: Advance online booking for trains is highly recommended because some trains are popular and sell out.
getting_around.es: Se recomienda mucho reservar los trenes por internet con antelación porque algunos son populares y se agotan.
getting_around.quote: Advance online booking is highly recommended, firstly because some trains are popular and will sell out

getting_around.en: A taxi is described as probably the safest way to get around a city, and locals say to call one in advance.
getting_around.es: Se describe el taxi como probablemente la forma más segura de moverse por la ciudad, y los locales aconsejan llamarlo con antelación.
getting_around.quote: Taxi is probably the most safe way to get around a city. Locals will tell you to call in advance.

getting_around.en: Speed in cities is limited to 50 km/h, though people drive fast anyway.
getting_around.es: El límite de velocidad en ciudad es de 50 km/h, aunque la gente conduce rápido igualmente.
getting_around.quote: Speed in cities is limited to 50 km/h. However people do drive fast anyway.

money.en: The currency is the hryvnia, abbreviated грн and symbolised ₴.
money.es: La moneda es la grivna, abreviada грн y con el símbolo ₴.
money.quote: The unit of currency is the hryvnia denoted by the abbreviation

money.en: ATMs are common throughout the country and generally work with international cards, nearly always dispensing hryvnia.
money.es: Los cajeros son comunes en todo el país y suelen funcionar con tarjetas internacionales, casi siempre dispensando grivnas.
money.quote: ATMs are common throughout the country and generally work with international cards. They nearly always dispense hryvnia, though you may find some give US dollars.

money.en: ATMs might not be refilled with cash and during power cuts ATMs and card terminals may not work.
money.es: Los cajeros pueden no reponerse con efectivo y durante los cortes de luz los cajeros y terminales de tarjeta pueden no funcionar.
money.quote: ATMs might not be refilled with cash and some bank cards might not be accepted. During power cuts, ATMs and card terminals may not work.

money.en: Use only official exchange booths and make sure you are given a receipt.
money.es: Usa solo casas de cambio oficiales y asegúrate de recibir un recibo.
money.quote: Only use official exchange booths and make sure you’re given a receipt.

money.en: Tipping about 6-10% in restaurants is normal, and rounding up is fine too.
money.es: Es normal dejar una propina de entre el 6 y el 10 % en restaurantes, y redondear la cuenta también es válido.
money.quote: About 6-10% is normal, but don't stress about the exact amount. Just rounding up is fine too.

money.en: By law all transactions must be in hryvnia, although less formal ones may be in euros or US dollars.
money.es: Por ley todas las transacciones deben hacerse en grivnas, aunque las informales pueden ser en euros o dólares.
money.quote: By law, all transactions are required to be in hryvnia, although less formal transactions may be in euros or US dollars.

etiquette.en: Ukrainians are described as a separate ethnic group from Russians who would be deeply offended if you say otherwise.
etiquette.es: Se describe a los ucranianos como un grupo étnico distinto de los rusos que se ofendería mucho si dices lo contrario.
etiquette.quote: Ukrainians are not Russians; they're a separate ethnic group and would be deeply offended if you say otherwise.

etiquette.en: Saying that the Ukrainian language is a dialect of Russian is incorrect and will upset those around you.
etiquette.es: Decir que el ucraniano es un dialecto del ruso es incorrecto y molestará a quienes te rodean.
etiquette.quote: Do not say that the Ukrainian language is a dialect of Russian. Not only is this incorrect, but it will also upset those around you.

etiquette.en: Referring to Ukrainian towns and places by their Russian names may be regarded as intentionally offensive.
etiquette.es: Usar los nombres rusos de ciudades y lugares ucranianos puede considerarse intencionadamente ofensivo.
etiquette.quote: Do not refer to Ukrainian towns and places by their Russian names; this may be regarded as intentionally offensive.

etiquette.en: If you speak English and Russian but not Ukrainian, it is appreciated to start in English even if you settle on Russian afterwards.
etiquette.es: Si hablas inglés y ruso pero no ucraniano, se agradece empezar en inglés aunque luego pases al ruso.
etiquette.quote: If you speak both English and Russian but not Ukrainian, it will be appreciated to start in the former even if you settle on Russian afterwards.

etiquette.en: Ukrainians are generally reserved and take time to gradually open up to people.
etiquette.es: Los ucranianos suelen ser reservados y tardan en abrirse poco a poco.
etiquette.quote: Ukrainians are generally reserved and take time to gradually open up to people.

etiquette.en: The Holodomor is regarded by Ukrainians as a genocide and is still an open wound in the national consciousness.
etiquette.es: Los ucranianos consideran el Holodomor un genocidio y sigue siendo una herida abierta en la conciencia nacional.
etiquette.quote: The event is regarded by Ukrainians as a genocide and is still an open wound in Ukraine's national consciousness.

connectivity.en: The biggest mobile operators are Kyivstar, Vodafone (formerly MTS) and Lifecell.
connectivity.es: Los mayores operadores móviles son Kyivstar, Vodafone (antes MTS) y Lifecell.
connectivity.quote: The biggest mobile phone operators Kyivstar, Vodafone (formerly MTS), Lifecell.

connectivity.en: 4G is available in all major cities and public Wi-Fi hotspots are widespread throughout cities.
connectivity.es: El 4G está disponible en todas las grandes ciudades y hay puntos wifi públicos por toda la ciudad.
connectivity.quote: 4G mobile access is steadily developing and is available now in all major cities. Public Wi-Fi hotspots are widespread throughout cities.

connectivity.en: Russian internet services have mostly been blocked by the Ukrainian Government since 2017.
connectivity.es: El gobierno ucraniano bloquea en su mayoría los servicios rusos de internet desde 2017.
connectivity.quote: Russian internet services have mostly been blocked by the Ukrainian Government since 2017.

connectivity.en: Wikivoyage advises downloading maps, as trains in rural areas are often not covered by mobile data.
connectivity.es: Wikivoyage aconseja descargar mapas, porque los trenes en zonas rurales a menudo no tienen cobertura de datos móviles.
connectivity.quote: Download the maps, as trains in rural areas are often uncovered by mobile data connection.
